environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in the 'workflow-tasks' namespace of an EKS cluster running Istio 1.19. All external traffic enters through the Istio IngressGateway in the 'istio-system' namespace. An AuthorizationPolicy resource in the 'workflow-tasks' namespace specifies: spec.action=DENY for requests where source.namespace is NOT in ['workflow-tasks', 'orchestration']. Additionally, a separate AuthorizationPolicy at mesh level (rootNamespace: istio-system) enforces that any request with a path matching '/prod/status*' must carry a valid RequestAuthentication JWT issued by the internal Step Functions callback service (issuer: 'arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/StepFunctionsCallbackRole'). The API Gateway endpoint is NOT publicly exposed; instead, traffic routes through a private NLB -> Istio IngressGateway -> VirtualService -> Lambda (via knative-serving bridge). The EnvoyFilter attached to the ingress gateway runs a Lua script that strips any query parameter value containing characters matching the pattern [<>"'();] before forwarding to the upstream Lambda, as a defense-in-depth measure against markup injection in URL parameters.

config.request_authentication: JWT required, issuer must be StepFunctionsCallbackRole
config.envoy_filter: Lua script strips <, >, ", ', (, ), ; from query param values
config.public_access: none - no public API Gateway endpoint
config.network_policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to istio-system only
